<function name="MarkTookDamageFromEnemy" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Marks the NPC as took damage from given entity.

See also <page>NPC:GetLastTimeTookDamageFromEnemy</page>.
	</description>
	<added>2022.06.08</added>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="enemy" type="Entity" default="nil">The enemy to mark. Defaults to currently active enemy (<page>NPC:GetEnemy</page>)</arg>
	</args>
</function>
